name: disorientation
description: A sense that you are in a strange environment where things are unpredictable.

variations.name: foreign place
variations.description: A sense that the current environment does not fit your preferences for language, food, manners, beliefs, architecture, or other social aspects.

variations.name: social disorientation
variations.description: Something fundamental has changed in social surroundings and you're not used to it yet.
examples: It's so weird that she's gone.

variations.name: unfamiliar activity
variations.description: A sense that you're participating in an activity where you're not competent and don't know what's expected.

variations.name: unfamiliar mindset
variations.description: You're feeling something unfamiliar coming from somewhere deep.

commentaries.quote: Disorientation may start with confusion about what you're perceiving. The confusion may dissapear when you shift perceptions, but with disorientation, there's nothing wrong with your perceptions -- it's your expectations that need to shift.

conditions: A sense that you are in a strange environment where things are unpredictable.
